rows.note: Use this as the ordinary all-purpose verb for taking a photograph.

example.english: Let’s snap some photos at the beach.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 jing2 soeng2 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the sharp speech is directed at someone as a scolding.

example.english: My boss tends to snap at me when I’m late.
example.traditional: 老闆見我遲到就會鬧我。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 gin3 ngo5 ci4 dou3 zau6 wui5 naau6 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for physically breaking something suddenly by bending or force, especially a stick or branch.

example.english: I bent the branch too hard and made it snap.
example.traditional: 我用力過度，整條樹枝拗斷咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 lik6 gwo3 dou6 zing2 tiu4 syu6 zi1 aau2 tyun5 zo2
